manual.title: Install in 5 steps
manual.intro: Until it is published in the stores, the extension is installed by hand. It takes about two minutes.
manual.s1_text: Download the ZIP file, right-click it and choose "Extract All". Keep the resulting folder in a fixed place, for example Documents: the browser reads it at every start.
manual.s2_text: Paste this address into the {{browser}} address bar, then press Enter. Browsers do not allow direct links to this page.
manual.s3_text_chrome: At the top right of the page, turn on the "Developer mode" switch.
manual.s3_text_edge: In the left-hand menu, turn on the "Developer mode" switch.
manual.s4_text_chrome: Click "Load unpacked", then choose the unzipped folder (the one containing manifest.json).
manual.s4_text_edge: Click "Load unpacked", then choose the unzipped folder (the one containing manifest.json).
manual.s4_text_opera: Click "Load unpacked", then choose the unzipped folder (the one containing manifest.json).
manual.s5_title: Pin the icon and sign in
manual.s5_text: Open the Extensions menu in the toolbar (puzzle-piece icon, or cube on Opera), pin Précis, then sign in with your Précis account.
manual.note_folder: Keep the folder: if it is deleted or moved, the extension stops working.
manual.note_update: No automatic updates. For a new version, download the ZIP, replace the folder's contents, then click "Reload" (circular arrow) on the Précis card. This page tells you when a newer version exists.
manual.note_alert: At startup, the browser may warn about developer-mode extensions: close the warning without turning them off.
manual.sub: Version {{version}} · Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi

price.text: The extension uses the pages of your Précis account: no separate subscription, nothing to buy to install it.

permissions.storage: Storage: keeps your session and preferences in the browser.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.browsers_a: Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi on desktop, version 120 or later. Mobile browsers do not allow installing extensions.
faq.account_q: Do I need a Précis account?
faq.account_a: Yes. The extension uses your account's credits. You can create one for free on the website.
faq.data_a: The page's text and images are sent only when you ask for a translation. We don't sell any data and show no ads.
faq.uninstall_a: Right-click the Précis icon, then choose "Remove from Chrome" or "Remove from Microsoft Edge". You can also use the browser's extensions page.
